record.paper: Popular progression differences in vector spaces II

dossier_meta.paper: Popular progression differences in vector spaces II
dossier_meta.statement_text: The bounds on the tower height of $n_p(\alpha,\beta)$ given in Theorem 2 should also hold for all primes $p < 19$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 2 is proved only for primes $p \geq 19$. The authors note that the upper bounds in Theorem 2 hold for all primes, and the lower bound holds when $\varepsilon = \alpha^3 - \beta$ is small. The obstacle for $p < 19$ in the large-$\varepsilon$ regime is that the best known bounds on the largest subset of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ without a three-term arithmetic progression are not strong enough to imply the required lower bound estimate in that case.
